Rules / Tool

SK9004 Two spellings of one option are set at equal specificity and disagree

Two spellings of the same option are set at the same specificity with different values, so precedence cannot pick one and whichever wins is an accident of file order. Delete one of the two lines; the report points at the loser and names the other.

CategoryTool
Default severitywarning
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.1

Why

Precedence between the spellings of one option is decided by specificity — a csharp_ key beats a generic one — and when two spellings sit at the same rank there is no rule left to apply. The same id is raised at build time by Rikarin.Skala.Options.Generator when options.json itself gives one spelling to two options: that is the same concept on the other side of the registry, mirrored because the generator cannot reference Core.

When it does not fire

⚠ The runtime form is currently unreachable, and a test asserts why: no option in the registry has two spellings at one specificity rank, because the ReSharper alias spellings were dropped and every option now has at most its skala_ key and one Microsoft-namespace alias at a different rank (SK9004_IsUnreachable_BecauseNoOptionHasTwoSpellingsAtOneRank). The branch is kept because it becomes reachable the day an option gains a second alias at an existing rank. The same key written twice is not this diagnostic — later wins, silently — and two spellings at different ranks that disagree are SK9005.
